statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and persistent dizziness that have significantly impacted daily activities.
A 48-hour ambulatory electrocardiogram (CPT code 93226) is ordered to capture cardiac rhythm during symptomatic periods.
The service is ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmic causes of these symptoms.
The diagnosis codes are R55 and R42.
The claim was denied based on Reason Code PR-204.
The denial reason is that the service is not covered under the patient's current benefit plan.
